description:
FOUND s492 (Fable, 2026-09-20) by the everyday-Perl battery (#1994, b2-28 a directory walker).  PRE-EXISTING on main 268d7e00.  Probes vs perl 5.40.3: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s492/probes/fspec1.pl, tmp1.pl.
  File::Spec->catdir("", "", "tmp") / ("", "tmp") / ("", @d[0..$#d-1])        perl /tmp /tmp /tmp      PCL tmp tmp tmp
  File::Spec->catdir("")                                                       perl /                  PCL ""
  File::Spec->abs2rel("/a/b/c", "/a")                                          perl b/c                PCL: Can't locate object method "abs2rel" via package "File::Spec"
  use File::Temp qw(tempdir); my $d = tempdir(CLEANUP => 1);                   perl: a directory       PCL: DIES (File::Temp builds the parent with catdir($volume, @dirs[0..$#dirs-1]))
  tempdir("nameXXXXXX", TMPDIR => 1, CLEANUP => 1) the same; `tempfile(...)`, `File::Temp->new` -- probe after the fix (not reached today).
CAUSE (read): lib/File/Spec.pm `sub catdir { ... my @parts = grep { defined $_ && $_ ne '' } @_; ...` -- every empty part is dropped, including the leading one that MEANS the root.
FIX SHAPE -- measure first, the better answer is probably to DELETE the shim: perl's own File::Spec::Unix is pure Perl (its XS is an optional accelerator; Cwd is needed only by rel2abs/abs2rel and PCL's Cwd shim loads).  Transpile the REAL File/Spec.pm + File/Spec/Unix.pm + File/Spec/Functions.pm, run perl's own dist test `t/Spec.t` (hundreds of rows, under cpan-tests or fetch PathTools -- dist fetches are blanket-OK'd) with perl as oracle, and compare rows shim vs real; if the real module passes more and costs < ~0.1 s warm to load (measure: File::Spec is loaded by almost everything), the shim goes (docs/shipped-modules.md says why it existed -- read it first; rule 9a prefers no shim to a divergent shim).  If the real one cannot load yet, FIX the shim function by function against that same t/Spec.t and FILE what blocks the real one.
ACCEPTANCE: tmp1.pl + fspec1.pl == perl; the battery's b2-28-real-dir-walker.pl == perl (File::Find + File::Path + File::Basename + File::Temp + Cwd in one 20-line script: ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s492/battery2/).
BAR: `lib/` => full sweep + the companion files that `use File::Spec`/`File::Temp` (`grep -a -l`) + the CPAN board by ROWS (File::Temp is in most dists' tests -- expect UPWARD movers; a row that arrives is not a new failure) + Pl/t guard rows (catdir table + tempdir) in an existing file-spec Pl/t file.


=== DONE (s492c, 2026-09-21, Opus) ===
`catdir` dropped EVERY empty part, including the LEADING one that means root.
catdir and catfile are now File::Spec::Unix's own shape (join with a trailing
empty component, then canonpath) rather than a filter, and `abs2rel` -- which
did not exist at all -- is the real algorithm with `_same` inlined.
`case_tolerant` added beside them.

fspec1.pl and tmp1.pl are identical to perl 5.40.3 except `File::Temp->new`,
which dies in File::Temp's `${*$fh}{...}` glob-as-object idiom -- filed #2056.
tempdir/tempfile/File::Temp::tempfile all work.

The "measure whether the REAL File::Spec::Unix can replace the shim" half
could NOT be taken and is filed as #2057 with what it needs: PCL's shim lib/
wins module resolution over any `use lib`, so the real module cannot be loaded
to compare, and PathTools' own t/Spec.t in its dist dir picks up the dist's XS
Cwd first.

Guard: three rows in Pl/t/file-spec-01.t (4 -> 7), inverse-verified.


=== DONE (s492c) ===
SHIPPED s492c member 3 (63773b13).  lib/File/Spec.pm's catdir dropped EVERY
empty component, including the LEADING one that means root, so catdir("",
"tmp") was "tmp" and File::Temp's tempdir(CLEANUP => 1) died "Parent directory
(tmp) does not exist".  catdir/catfile are now File::Spec::Unix's own shape
and abs2rel (absent entirely) is the real algorithm.  MEASURED FIRST, as the
task asked: the REAL File::Spec::Unix cannot be substituted here (PCL's shim
lib/ wins module resolution) -- filed #2057.  Guard Pl/t/file-spec-01.t, 3 new
rows.  Residue: File::Temp->new still dies in the ${*$fh}{...} glob-as-object
idiom, filed #2056.
subject: EVERYDAY (File::Temp, File::Spec): `File::Temp::tempdir(CLEANUP => 1)` -- the commonest call -- DIES "Error in tempdir() using /tmp/XXXXXXXXXX: Parent directory (tmp) does not exist", because the `lib/File/Spec.pm` SHIM's `catdir` drops a LEADING EMPTY component (`catdir("", "tmp")` is "tmp", perl "/tmp"; `catdir("")` is "", perl "/"); the shim also has no `abs2rel`
